scale_exact: 1/8 = 2^-3, power of two -> the MUL is exact in fp16 (no rounding)
reference: float64 canonical softmax exp(v)/sum(exp(v)), v = fp16_input*1/8 + mask
input_source: frozen fixture (ticket 02) q/k projections of the named layer; x = unit-RMS random direction * measured input_layernorm gamma
tolerance_rationale: registered BEFORE the board run. fp16 output magnitude ~1/(i+1) in [0.125,1]; 1 ULP at 0.125 is 1.22e-4, and a device/CPU 1-ULP difference on 1/7 is 8.5e-4 relative. atol=1e-3 = 8 ULP at 0.125 (must also cover the masked positions whose expected value is exactly 0); rtol=5e-3 = 5.9x the relative 1-ULP of 0.125. Both are far below the repo default 2e-2 and above the measured noise floor (see docs/OP-masked-softmax.md §6).
prediction: P1 compile: EXIT=0, single Execution Step on MDLA_5_0, layers = ElementWiseMulLayer + ElementWiseAddLayer + SoftMaxLayer, no bridge.
P2 masked positions: device output is EXACTLY 0.0 (all fp16 bits zero).
P3 mask magnitude -4096 vs -8192: the two board dumps are BIT-IDENTICAL (finite mask saturated => behaves like the ideal -inf mask).
P4 zero mask => plain softmax over all 8 entries; masked-run/zero-run ratio at visible positions is the per-row constant S_all/S_visible.
P5 noise floor (same .dla, same inputs, 2 runs) == 0 (deterministic hardware).
P6 layer0 scores have |s|max=513.8 with per-head offsets +-500; if the device does NOT subtract the row max, exp(468) overflows fp16 -> NaN (this run answers it).
